collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.
collection.description: A gardener's neighbor lost a whole bed of seedlings to a late storm, and planting season is nearly over.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A gardener's neighbor lost a whole bed of seedlings to a late storm, and planting season is nearly over.

choices.label: Suggest a Village Seed Store for Next Time.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The late planting grows poorly, but the neighbor is grateful the attempt was possible.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Some seedlings wilt in the new soil, and the two gardeners compare notes on why.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: They disagree about spacing the rows, and each plants half their own way.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Several households agree to keep spare seeds in one dry place.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: Nobody can agree on who should keep the store, and the idea waits for another meeting.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The neighbor plants in time, and the garden recovers by the end of the season.
